_description: Zendesk audit-log + ticket-audit (/api/v2/audit_logs, /api/v2/tickets/{id}/audits) → AKSI control ID mapping. Zendesk is the dominant customer-service platform; AI agents (Zendesk AI Agents, Salesforce Service Cloud, custom bots) increasingly handle support tickets directly. Every public-facing reply by an AI is a regulated brand-voice + accuracy + compliance event. Each audit row carries an actor (actor_is_ai flag, actor_ai_model name, author_role), a list of events (Comment / Notification / Create / Change / VoiceComment with public flag and via.channel), and metadata. The (actor_is_ai, event-type, public, via.channel, field_name) tuple drives the primary control. Public AI replies, autonomous status transitions to solved/closed, AI-driven priority/assignee changes, voice responses, negative customer feedback, programmatic ticket creation, and consecutive AI-only replies produce additive flags or fails. Cross-channel surface (one AI actor across > N channels), high-volume AI handling (one model > N tickets in 1h), and elevated bad-satisfaction rates yield synthetic findings.
